Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished Instagram educational carousel card for AXOMRANK, strictly SQUARE 1:1. Premium aesthetic tactile 3D editorial study journal. Ivory #F7F2EC paper, maroon #80151A raised typography/plaques, charcoal #292929 copy, restrained gold, subtle red-and-white Assamese gamosa-inspired woven edge. Soft studio light, convincing depth and ambient shadows, clean mobile-readable layout, substantial negative space. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match ivory, maroon, woven accents and dimensional hierarchy, DO NOT reproduce its Sukapha figure or text. Reference image 2, where supplied, is an AI Lachit portrait for subject appearance, not an authentic historical portrait. Render clean bold sans-serif copy EXACTLY, no extra text. Header "AXOMRANK" with "ASSAM STUDY JOURNAL". Footer "Source: Kamrup District, Govt. of Assam". No invented logo, no Rang Ghar, no faux historical quotes.
COVER. Clear hook in huge lettering upper-left: "SARAIGHAT, 1671" then "Why did the river matter?" Supporting tiny line "Lachit • Ahoms • Brahmaputra". Right half: striking 3D cutout portrait of Lachit from image 2, cream turban/tunic, red trim, sword; project him over a small elegant dimensional river ribbon and two miniature wooden boats. Subtle dramatic lighting but educational, not fantasy. Bottom CTA "Swipe to connect the facts →". Small label by artwork "AI illustration". Counter "01/06".
